texts.zh: 用以决出联邦领袖的黄金律挑战赛将在数日后举行。由当前的联邦领袖开始，联邦中的每个帝国都有机会进行投标，直至仅剩一个参与国为止。这一投标国就是被选出的联邦领袖。
texts.en: In a few days the Golden Rule challenge for federation leadership will commence. Starting with the current leader: each empire in the federation will have a chance to place bids, until only one participant remains. That bidder is then elected leader of the federation.

texts.zh:
用以决出联邦领袖的黄金律挑战赛将在数日后举行。由当前的联邦领袖开始，联邦中的每个帝国都有机会进行投标，直至仅剩一个参与国为止。这一投标国就是被选出的联邦领袖。

不幸的是，由于我们不是一个独立的国家，我们被禁止参加，因为我们没有资格领导联邦。
texts.en:
In a few days the Golden Rule challenge for federation leadership will commence. Starting with the current leader: each empire in the federation will have a chance to place bids, until only one participant remains. That bidder is then elected leader of the federation.

Unfortunately, as we are not an independent state, we are barred from participation as we are not eligible to lead the federation.

texts.zh:
是时候由[Root.GetName]在黄金律挑战赛中投标了。要么预付所需的价码，要么选择放弃——亦即失去进一步参赛的权利。

当前投标总额为：

£energy£ [bidding_federation_leader.current_pot_variable]
texts.en:
It is time for the [Root.GetName] to place a bid in the Golden Rule challenge. Pay the required price up front, or else forfeit - and lose the right to participate further.

The current pot is:

£energy£ [bidding_federation_leader.current_pot_variable]

texts.zh:
黄金律挑战赛落下帷幕，优胜者已然决出！

[event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetName]证明了自己的金融霸权，并成为了新的联邦领袖。
texts.en:
The Golden Rule challenge has come to an end, and a winner has been declared!

The [event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetName] has proven their financial superiority, and becomes the new federation leader.

title.en: To the Victor Go the Spoils

texts.zh:
依据黄金律挑战赛的规则，[Root.GetName]被委任为联邦领袖。恭喜！

接下来要做的第一件事，就是决定用这些“奖金”来做些什么。奖金总额为£energy£[bidding_federation_leader.current_pot_variable]。

注意：某些强制税款和费用可能适用，这会明显改变实际给出的数额。
texts.en:
[Root.GetName] has been appointed Federation Leader in accordance with the rules for the Golden Rule challenge. Congratulations!

The first order of business is to decide what will happen with the 'prize money'. The current sum is £energy£ [bidding_federation_leader.current_pot_variable].

Note that some mandatory taxes and fees will apply, effectively altering the sum before pay-out.

title.en: To the Victor Go the Spoils

texts.zh:
黄金律联邦挑战已经落下帷幕，投标罐中余下了大笔财富。[event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetName]作为这笔资金新选出的管理人作出了如下宣告：

“我们当把这些经费投资回给[federation.GetName]，这样我们就能共同促进经济的发展。[event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetGoldenRuleDebrief]”
texts.en:
The Golden Rule federation challenge has concluded with a substantial amount of wealth left in the bidding pot. As newly-elected steward of this bounty, the [event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetName] has made the following proclamation:

"We shall invest these funds back into the [federation.GetName], so that we may stimulate growth in our shared economy. [event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetGoldenRuleDebrief]"

texts.zh:
黄金律联邦挑战已经落下帷幕，投标罐中余下了大笔财富。[event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetName]作为这笔资金新选出的管理人作出了如下宣告：

“[federation.GetName]应当把这些经费平均地分发回给成员国，让各自决定以最合适的方式利用。[event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetGoldenRuleDebrief]”
texts.en:
The Golden Rule federation challenge has concluded with a substantial amount of wealth left in the bidding pot. As newly-elected steward of this bounty, the [event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetName] has made the following proclamation:

"The [federation.GetName] shall distribute these funds evenly to its members, to be utilized as each of us sees fit. [event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetGoldenRuleDebrief]"

texts.zh:
黄金律联邦挑战已经落下帷幕，投标罐中余下了大笔财富。[event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetName]作为这笔资金新选出的管理人作出了如下宣告：

“我们应当保留这些经费作为我们担任联邦主席的首付款。[event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetGoldenRuleDebrief]”
texts.en:
The Golden Rule federation challenge has concluded with a substantial amount of wealth left in the bidding pot. As newly-elected steward of this bounty, the [event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetName] has made the following proclamation:

"We shall retain the funds as downpayment against our tenure as Federation President. [event_target:federation_bidding_winner.GetGoldenRuleDebrief]"
